text.en:
Dodging Grants x1 Stat Boost to you and allies within 15 meters for 15 seconds.

While Stat Boost is active:
• Kills or Dodges grant an additional Stack (maximum of 5) and refresh the duration of the buff.
• Allies within 10 meters receive the same stack amount of Stat Boost as the owner when the buff is refreshed.

Stat Boost Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:
• 30 | 35 | 40 | 45 | 50 Airborne Effectiveness
• 40? | 40(?) | 45(?) | 50(?) | 55(?) Handling
• 40 | 40 | 45 | 50 | 55 Reload Speed
• 1x | 0.925x | 0.915x | 0.91x | 0.89x Reload Duration Multiplier

Dodging Grants 1 Stack of Tight Fit to the wearer and allies within 15 meters for 15 seconds.

While Tight Fit is active:
• Kills or Dodges grant an additional Stack up to a maximum of 5 and refresh the duration of the buff.
• Allies within range receive the same Stack amount of Tight Fit as the owner when the buff is refreshed.

Stat Boost Bonuses at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks:

• 40? | 40? | 45? | 50? | 55? Handling
• 40 | 40 | 45 | 50 | 55 Reload Speed

Dealing Weapon Damage generates Class Ability Energy. Scoring multiple Direct Weapon Hits within ? seconds of each grants ~20% Class Ability Energy. 

Activation progress granted by weapon type:
• Submachine Guns, Trace Rifles: 7.14%
• Auto Rifles, Machine Guns: 8.33%
• Pulse Rifles: 9.1%
• Sidearms: 12.5%
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 16.7%
• Swords: 20% 
• Bows, Glaives, Grenade Launchers, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles: 34%

Class Ability usage reloads all equipped weapons and grants you 1 Stack of 'Tight Fit' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. #Reload

Allies within 15 meters receive the same number of stacks as you have after the Class Ability usage.

• 40|40|45|50|55 Reload Speed
• 0%|7.5%|8.5%|9%|11% decreased Reload Animation Duration
• 40?|40?|45?|50?|55? Handling
